Microphone is off.

This detects breath-like noise, not airflow. Speech, wind, or music may still trigger it. Use headphones if the notes trigger more bubbles.

Allow microphone access, then stay quiet for two seconds. Blow gently for 1–3 seconds and stop. A longer breath makes a larger, lower note.
